sourceRefs: Problem 5 section, added 2026-08-04 after a second live debugging session

acceptance: Read docs/04/supervisor_dispatch_refactor_proposal_2026-08-04.md section 'Problem 5' in full before starting -- it contains the confirmed root cause, the live repro (four separate blocked tasks fixed by hand on 2026-08-04, none of which the supervisor would have noticed on its own), and the exact design shape. Do not deviate from that shape without discussing first.

Confirmed live fact, do not re-derive: dispatch_ready_tasks's owned_statuses/review_statuses/finalize_statuses (ready_dispatcher config) never include 'blocked' -- a blocked task is structurally invisible to the entire dispatch scan until an explicit reopen/assign-class command fires. This is the root cause; do not treat it as a per-task bug.

Confirmed live fact: SUP-L12-STALE-PR-RETIRE-20260729, SUP-L12-STALE-FAILURE-STREAK-REAPER-20260729, SUP-L12-STALE-REAPER-EXACT-HEAD-RECONCILE-20260731, SUP-L12-STALE-REAPER-EVIDENCE-ANCHOR-REPAIR-20260731(+V2), SUP-L12-HELD-CLOSE-OVERLAP-GUARD-20260731 are prior point-patch attempts at this same problem shape; every one of them is itself sitting blocked on Human/Ops as of 2026-08-04, and none landed a generic mechanism in supervisor.py ('reaper' in code today only prunes stale worktree directories, an unrelated concept).

Extend the blocker record (command_blocker / state['blockers']) with an OPTIONAL check_kind field plus kind-specific params, e.g. {"check_kind": "github_pr_ci", "pr_number": N} or {"check_kind": "task_dependency", "task_id": X, "required_status": "done"}. Omitting check_kind must behave exactly as today (a pure human-judgment block nothing auto-clears) -- this field is purely additive and opt-in.

Add a new function (e.g. reconcile_blocked_tasks(config, state)) that runs on its OWN interval, separate from and much less frequent than the ~30s main dispatch tick, since it makes external GitHub API calls and must not add latency or rate-limit pressure to the hot dispatch cycle. For each open blocker with a check_kind set, re-sample the real current fact and, if resolved, drive the task through the exact same transition reopen already performs today -- do not invent a new state-machine path, only an automatic trigger for the existing one.
github_pr_ci check_kind: resolve via the same mechanism scripts/git/github_review_bridge.py or gh already uses to read PR status-check-rollup; resolved means all required contexts are SUCCESS.
task_dependency check_kind: resolved means the referenced task_id's status equals required_status.

Explicit success criterion: this change must be able to retire SUP-L12-STALE-PR-RETIRE-20260729, SUP-L12-STALE-FAILURE-STREAK-REAPER-20260729, SUP-L12-STALE-REAPER-EXACT-HEAD-RECONCILE-20260731, SUP-L12-STALE-REAPER-EVIDENCE-ANCHOR-REPAIR-20260731(+V2), and SUP-L12-HELD-CLOSE-OVERLAP-GUARD-20260731 as superseded by this generic mechanism. If it cannot absorb what those tasks were trying to do, the design is still too narrow -- go back to the proposal doc, do not ship a sixth point patch.

Add tests: a github_pr_ci blocker that resolves after CI flips green auto-reopens the task; a task_dependency blocker resolves when the dependency reaches required_status; a check_kind-less (legacy) blocker is never auto-touched; the reconciliation pass does not run on the hot dispatch tick.
Shadow-verify per rewrite/shadow.py discipline before cutover; ship behind a flag, incumbent one flag away, consistent with every other SUPERVISOR-REWRITE phase.
Do not touch poll_workers, process_queue, or reconcile_queue_records.
task_spec.summary: Root-cause fix for a pattern hit four separate times live on 2026-08-04: blocked is a one-way door in dispatch_ready_tasks (owned/review/finalize status lists never include it), so a task whose blocking condition later resolves (CI turns green, a dependency finishes) stays frozen until a human manually reopens it. The codebase already has five prior one-off 'reaper' tasks attempting fragments of this same fix, and all five are themselves stuck blocked as of today -- proof point patches don't compose. This task builds the one generic mechanism instead and must be able to retire all five as superseded.
task_spec.title: Add structured, checkable blockers and a generic blocked-task reconciliation pass
